text: 안녕 세븐틴. 너희는 나에게 정말 소중하고 중요한 존재야. 처음으로 너희를 만난 건 유튜브에서 너희 노래를 우연히 듣게 됬을 때야. 그 순간 나는 '와, 세븐틴이 이런 그룹이구나'라는 생각이 들었어. 그때부터 너희에 대해 더 알아가며 자연스럽게 입덕하게 된 것 같아. 특히, 너희가 캐럿들에게 보내는 진심 어린 마음이 정말 좋아.위버스 글이나 유튜브에서 느껴지는 너희의 진정성 덕분에 항상 고맙고, 너희 덕분에 웃는 날이 많았어. 세븐틴이 이렇게 열심히 노력하며 캐럿들을 아껴주는 데 나는 세븐틴을 위해서 한게 없는 것 같아. 하지만, 나 역시 세븐틴을 정말 사랑하고 있다는 걸 꼭 알아줬으면 해. 세븐틴은 이제 나의 인생에서 절대 잊을 수 없는 존재가 되었어.세븐틴은 내가 힘들 때 나의 곁에 있어 주었기 때문에 나도 언제나 너희를 기억하고 사랑할 수밖에 없어. 세븐틴이 어떤 길을 가더라도, 캐럿들은 변함없이 응원하고 지지할 거야. 세븐틴이 힘들 때 항상 옆에서 힘이 되어주는 캐럿이 될게. 항상 고마워.

SVT is my comfort and I'm grateful for being a carat.

Unlike most of the carats I've seen in the comsec, I'm actually doing good. — is what I thought. Until the song reached the bridge and made me cry a bit. I didn't know the lyrics at all but it still made me tear up. 

I listened to it again, this time with a lyrics translation I found here in the comsec as well as in the video itself. It made me bawl my eyes out so hard.

"One day we'll be standing firm on these waves."
"Let's take a moment to catch our breath."
"The warmth and smiles at the end of the road will protect us from the time quickly passing us by."
 "You can slow down a bit."

All of these are words I never heard from anyone but seemingly the exact words I needed at this moment. Thank you SEVENTEEN.

얘들아, 나 뿐만 아니라 많은 캐럿들이 이 노래를 많이 찾는것 같아. 너희의 말속에 ‘군대’를 암시하는 언급들이 많아지니까 그런것 같아. 군백기라는 일이 참 먼 일 같았는데 그 시간이 점점 가까워지고 있다는걸 우리 서로가 잘 알고 있는 것 같아. 승철이 면제 받은거 이미 예상은 했지만 승철이를 시작으로 우리는 오랜 시간 ’완전체‘가 너무 소중했지만 요즘 더더욱 소중하고 뭉클한 단어 같아. 2024년도 벌써 5월의 막바지고 다음주면 벌써 반년이 지났는데, 그 시간동안 쉬지 않고 활동해준 너희들이 참 고맙고 기특해. 나나투어부터 고잉까지 볼게 많아졌고, 개인의 잡지 촬영도 많아졌지. 하나하나 아껴서 보다보면 금방 시간이 빨리 가겠지? 
너희 덕분에 하루하루가 즐겁고, 행복한 시간을 보내고 있는 팬들이 많아. 그래서 이번 활동 열심히 해준 너희가 고맙기도 하다가 안쓰럽기도해. 얼마나 힘들까싶어,,! 쉴틈없이 달려온 이 시간에 군대에서 너희가 더 성장하고 있으면 우리도 우리대로 더 성장해있는 그런 팬이 되어볼게 !! 우리 서로 항상 건강하고 행복하자 ~

너희 모두와 함께할수 있는 시간이 정말 얼마 남지 않았다는걸 떠올릴 때마다 더 많이 사랑해야지 하고 다짐하곤해.
팬의 입장에서도 안쓰러울만큼 숨막히는 스케줄 속에서도 늘 웃으며 캐럿들을 위해서라면 힘낼 수 있다는 너희에게..... 내가 해줄수 있는건 그 자리에서 그저 기다리는 것 뿐이겠지?
완전체로 보내는 얼마 남지 않은 시간동안 부디 너희가 다치지 않고 또 너무 애쓰지 않았으면 좋겠어... 우린 이 자리에서 그대로 있을거야.
얼마나 걸릴지는 모르지만, 기쁘게 기다리고 있을게.
무슨 일 있어도 우린 꼭 다시 만날거야.

author: @chiefcatto
text:
Coming back to here again because of CARAT Day.

Hmm.. where to start? Well. I joined the fandom on 2017. I just started collage, and experienced my first concert (Diamond Edge). I remember that I saved my money for that. And I never regret that decision even I only lasted a year before another group snatched me away for months. After that? Well. Lets see. College life was busy and hard, so I ended up being so damn away with the boys.

4 years later, during Pandemic, I had a really hard time. My dad got diagnosed with cancer and my parents got covid right before my dad’s first chemo. My grandpa also passed away during that time. That was rough. I felt so lost. Until, my fyp showed me SEVENTEEN during their Be The Sun concert. They showed me light. They showed me that there will be sunshine after the rain. They made me learn that I will be okay at the end of the day.

Once I got back to the fandom, I realized that SEVENTEEN already big enough until I can find many CARATs when I went out. I felt so bad for being away for too long, yet also feel nice that I am able to find my way home.

Now I am stuck in here. In this Diamond Life. And I am grateful. Thank you for guiding me to the right way, SEVENTEEN. You always told us that we saved you… but it is actually both ways. You saved some of us too.

Lets walk together for a really long time. 🩷🩵

I can never be grateful enough to seventeen and now i love them tooo muchhh

author: @yijuniflo
text:
나는 나의 이야기를 당신과 나누고 싶다 매력적인 청춘은 많은 변수들로 가득 차 있다 예전에는 나는 항상 성숙한 척하는 것을 좋아했다 가족들의 눈에 철이 드는 아이가 되기를 희망했다.
낯선 길에서 맞닥뜨릴 수 있을 만큼 마음이 강하다고 상상하지만 내 모습은 그렇지 않다.
내성적인 성격으로 인해 고민이 생기고, 사람들과 어울리기 위해 노력하는 것을 강요하는 것이 낯설어 하는 자신은 남에게 폐를 끼치는 것을 싫어하고, 가끔 힘든 일로 슬그머니 이불에 숨어서 울고, 항상 부정적인 감정을 스스로 해소하는 법을 배운다.
이 따뜻한 힘을 줘서 고마워 힘든 나날들 힘든 여정을 보내며 눈앞의 불안함을 점점 사라지게 해 주었어 네가 아니었으면 난 지금 같은 사람이 될 수 없었을 것 같아 내 인생도 너로 인해 더 행복했어 너의 존재가 햇살처럼 들어와 다시 살아가길 바랬어 이제 난 더 긍정적이고 밝아졌어 세상을 마주하며 지금의 순간순간을 살아가는 뜨거운 나를 진정한 나로 받아들이려고 시도했어.
화려한 무대에서 무거운 부담을 안고 힘들고 지치는 순간이 올지도 모른다 가끔 발걸음을 멈추고 쉬어도 된다 자신에게 조금 더 너그럽게 대해주고 나를 많이 사랑하고 어떤 모습의 너를 보여주는지 기억하자 하지만 나는 그것이 행복한 너였으면 좋겠다.
13명이 어깨동무를 하고 먼 곳을 바라보는 모습 서로 행복한 모습을 소중히 여기며 언제 봐도 아름다운 미래의 어느 날을 떠올려보면 더 이상 젊지 않아도 그 소중한 사랑은 변함없을 거라 믿어요 가슴은 계속 뜨겁게 뛰어요 더 많은 아름다운 풍경을 함께 보고 더 많은 새로운 일을 맞이해요 우리 각자 바쁘게 살아요 서로가 서로에게 의지하는 힘이 되어 쉽게 당신의 손을 놓지 않을 거예요.
오빠~밥 잘 챙겨먹고 아프지 말고 항상 자랑스럽고 멋진 존재로 보여줘서 고마워 사랑해 알지~
그리고 저는 바다가 너무 좋아요. 파도가 치는 소리를 들으면서 바닷바람이 부는 것을 느끼는 것이 저에게는 힐링이고 추천합니다.

author: @Seolmi116
text:
세븐틴 덕에 무료하고 반복되는 일상 속에서도 그나마 웃을 수 있고, 세븐틴은 별 볼일 없는 것 같던 나를 빛나는 보석으로 만들어줬어.
세븐틴이 항상 캐럿을 위하고 아끼고 사랑하는 만큼
나를 포함한 모든 캐럿들도 세븐틴이라면 뭐든지 좋아할 거야.
우리 요즘 가장 바라는 게 '영원'이라는 건데
사실 영원하는 게 정말 쉬운 일이 아니고 나도 그걸 알기에 평소에 영원이라는 단어를 거의 쓰지 않는데
세븐틴에게는 영원하자는 말을 항상 해주고 싶어.
세븐틴이 나에게 정말 소중한 존재이기에, 나에게 용기와 행복과 위로를 건네준 존재이기에,
먼 훗 날, 내가 점점 기억을 잃어가는 때가 오더라도 세븐틴만큼은 끝까지 내 기억 속에 새겨져 있었으면 좋겠어.
세븐틴과 함께한 시간이 그리 길지는 않지만 세븐틴과 함께한 순간들만큼은 항상 행복만 가득했던 것 같아.
우리 나중에 정말 어쩔 수 없는 이유 때문에 잠시 멀어지고 떨어지더라도
꼭 다시 만나서 같이 노래 부르자 :)
세븐틴은 내 인생에서 가장 빛나는 순간일지도 모르는 지금 내 청춘 중에서도 가장 빛나는 기억일 거고, 아마 앞으로도 오래 동안 그럴 거야.
나의 아이돌, 내 인생의 원동력, 나의 기쁨.
나에게 와줘서 너무 고맙고 앞으로도 오래 함께하자, 우리.
매일 세븐틴과 함께라 행복하고 조금이나마 세븐틴을 더 빛나게 해줄 수 있음에 감사해.

author: @wonder2-track10
text:
Wrote this when I was stable enough.
I entered this fandom in 2017, I went through a lot with SEVENTEEN. From the point which I was a sixth grader to this, a highschooler. The journey I walked with them was so long, I can't see the end. Until my crisis breaks out in 2020, I wouldn't bother being alive, let alone SEVENTEEN. That's when my adoration for them eroded. Two years without SEVENTEEN, I felt so alone in this big wide world. I forgot how to laugh genuinely and get my heart moved by somebody. I thought I would never deserve loving SEVENTEEN, but then I listened to this song in Feb 2022. I cried so much. It had been a long time since I last felt something "real" like that. Not gonna lie, Smile Flower was my dose of healing back then. Now, 우리, 다시 is my life savior and my safe place. I'm so thankful of SEVENTEEN making it known to CARATs that they are by their side, they are the shoulders for them to cry on. 
SEVENTEEN meant a world to me in 2017, it has not changed. They are my querencia. They taught me to always be determined in what I am doing. Hoshi taught me not to live up to others' expectations but to my own (He said this in the Diamond Edge concert) I will forever cherish this love I receive from them. It is not just about music, having an idol. It is having someone who is sympathetic and support you on your path of life.
Thank you SEVENTEEN.

author: @은돌-x6z
text:
요즘따라 우리가 헤어질까봐 두려워.
재계약도 했고 명호와 준휘도 돌아와서 이제 건강히 컴백하고 캐럿들과 좋은 추억만 쌓으면 되는데 어째서 불안한걸까..? 

너네가 해체하고 나면 내 삶의 이유가 사라질 것 같을 정도로 너네가 내 삶의 큰 영향을 끼치고 있어.
너희가 우리곁에 없을 거라는게 안믿긴다. 재계약해서 아직 시간이 남아있지만 그마저도 지나가버리면 어쩔까 .. 이런 생각이 자주 든다.
그냥 내 맘을 말할 곳이 없어서 이렇게라도 말하게 되는 것같아. 너네는 충분히 잘하고 있으니까 지금만큼만 열심히 해줘.





to. 승철이
내 최애다 ㅎㅎ 요즘따라 승철이의 리더로써의 부담감이 많다는걸 내가 직접 더 느끼는 것같아. 그래서 그런가 너에게 애정이 더 가고 힘든일이 있으면 옆에서 지켜주는 사람이 되고 싶네.

to 정한
세븐틴 둘째네 ㅎㅎ 너도 쿱스못지않게 힘든일이 많을 것같아. 처음에는 그냥 예쁘게 생긴 아이다. 라고만 기억하고 있었는데 지금은 너가 내 기쁨이자 행복이 되가고 있네. 앞으로도 잘부탁해.

to. 지수
먼 타지에 와서 적응하고 사람들에게 알려지는게  쉽지만은 않았을텐데 그걸 감수하고 세븐틴으로 데뷔해줘서 고마워. 지수야. 뇨롱웃음을 볼 때마다
나도 저절로 웃게 되는 마법이 있더라.

to. 준휘
중국에서 와서 모든게 새롭기도 하지만 두려웠던 일들도 있었을 것 같아. 너가 빠져서 11명에서 활동할때 너의 빈자리가 크다는 걸 실감했어.
준휘야 너는 세븐틴에 보석이자 행복이야.

to. 순영
순영이 사진은 멀쩡한 사진보다는 엽사나 짤이 더 많은 것 같아. 퍼포먼스의 리더로써 우리 세븐틴의 안무를 짜줘서 고마워. 항상 다른 느낌으로 안무를 짜야되서 힘들 것같은데 너의 책임이라고 생각하고 항상 열정적이게 행동해줘서 고맙다.

to.  원우
요즘따라 너에게 신경이 많이 간다. 잘 울지도 않고 항상 멤버들을 위로해주는 입장이였을것같은데 지금은 너가 멤버들에게 안겨서 울어도 된다고 생각해. 너의 감정표현을 마음껏해도 뭐라할 사람은 없으니까.

to 지훈 
우리 보컬팀 보스, 우리 세븐틴의 모든 곡을 작사 작곡 해줘서 고마워 너가 멤버들만의 특성을 잘알아서 아이들에게 딱 맞는 파트를 선물해주는게 놀라웠어. 승철이하고 가장 오랫동안 연습생 생활을 해서 힘들었을 것같은데 세븐틴으로 데뷔해줘서 고맙다.

to 명호
누구보다도 감수성이 뛰어나고 항상좋은 말을 캐럿들에게 선물해주는 명호야 지금도 충분히 잘하고 있으니까 더 승승장구하자. 타국으러 와서 캐럿에게 와줘서 고맙다.

to 민규
우리 세븐틴의 비주얼 담당 민규야. 항상  즐거운 마음씨로 지내면서 우리에게 웃음을 줘서 고마워.
항상 멀리서 응원할게

to. 석민 
겉으로는 바보같이 보이지만 속은 여리고 순수한 아이인 석민아, 어떠한 일이 잘 안풀려서 너 자신 스스로를 탓하지 않았으면 좋겠다. 너의 목소리가 더 많은 사람들에게 알려질 수 있도록 캐럿들이 더 노력할게.

to. 승관
세븐틴이 재미있는 그룹으로 각인 된거는 승관이의 공이 정말 크다고 생각해. 이영지님께서 말씀 해주신 것처럼 너의 매력은 다양하고 그걸 다른 이들에게 보여주는 게 좋다고 생각해. 본업도 열심히 해줘서 고맙다.

to. 버논
위화논 국밥 보이 벌농씨 처음에는 좀 벌농씨가 비주얼 멤버인줄 알았지만 사실은 국밥 멤버였다는 게  너무 놀랍단..

to. 찬
우리 찬이 막내로써 말하지 못할 고충들이 있을 것같은데 그럼에도 불구하고 항상 행복한 웃음으로 캐럿들을 대해줘서 고마워 .  우리 수달이 너가 나 삼애다. 항상 사랑한다

text:
Just wanna share something here. No need to read this, but if u want go ahead ^^
This is sort of a heavy topic so

My 2021 wasn't very good at all. Been having extreme burnouts in online classes, and for my last year in Junior High School, I had to move schools. It was way different than my previous school which overwhelmed me (and again, this was online classes-)

Though I still had my friends (I love them so much. Still with me up to now ❤️), it was very tough, and it was hard to try and reach out to my classmates and ask for guidance from the teachers.

I've attempted twice. It feels so scary, but still I'm trying my best to graduate and move up.

I watch their GoSe episodes when I just needed to feel happiness, even if it was for a short time. I listen to their songs: songs like Left & Right, Lucky, Call Call Call, and more to make me feel hype and active while working, or songs like To You, Hug, Come to Me, and more to comfort me when I'm at my lowest.

And to Carats, too. From funny comments you guys make and edits of our boys made by ya'll just made me happy. Thank you so much.

With this, I will do my best to continue. Currently, I'm about to enter 3rd Quarter of my school year (trying to finish any missed tasks and projects in 2nd quarter for this and next week).

A big thank you to Seventeen for comforting me whenever I felt very lonely, and for showing me that there are many things waiting for me in the future even if there are problems that try to stop me, I'll fight back. I'm glad to be in this family. I love you, Seventeen and Carats.

'Till the last "Say the name!" ❤️💎

author: @melissaa.4189
text:
I'm a type of person who rarely ask for help. I am someone who don't know how to ask for help or comfort. All I have that comforts me are songs, novels, and my art. I know this might sound overdramatic but this song just somehow give me assurance that I can live my life in my own pace in this bustling life, especially college seems so scary and difficult and my future and goals seems distant and blurry. Seventeen, thank you for reminding me to walk our journey in our own pace. Thank you for comforting me with this song. You may not be with our side every time but because of your songs, we can feel the warmth and won't feel alone, especially at the times where we are at our lowest point. Thank you for existing! And all I ask for you to do, just like any other carats, is to live happily, follow where your heart is at peace and always take care of yourselves! Someday, may our paths cross and share a wonderful memories. Until then, I need to study hard first!

To everyone out there, I hope this song will comfort you, especially at your darkest times. I hope you find time to rest and have someone to guide and be there for you! I hope you'll have a time to breathe and appreciate the people and the little things around you. Hoping you, the one who is reading this, have a blessed day ahead! Stay safe everyone!

author: @Maria-tg9ss
text:
Seventeen ¿Qué es seventeen para mi? Ustedes no son solamente mis ídolos, esta conexión va más allá de eso; Seventeen es mi vida, mi alegría, ustedes me han ayudado demasiado y se que siempre estarán ahí para mí, por ustedes me levanto mis queridos, ustedes son mis compañeros, mis amigos, las personas que me hacen feliz y los que me recuerdan que todo va a estar bien pasé lo que pasé , estoy tan agradecida con ustedes chicos, y como ustedes lo dicen con un simple gracias no basta, esa palabra tan sencilla quiero que suene sincera, muchísimas gracias por estar conmigo y por haberme permitido conocerlos y amarlos. Me hacen feliz, espero y nunca alejarme de ustedes, me de un terror el solo pensar que eso podría pasar alguna vez y de nuevo están ustedes deseando que nunca sienta eso, que solo sea feliz y claro que lo soy con ustedes chicos.
Espero que tengan buena salud, les deseo felicidad plena y ustedes pueden superar todo porque recuerden que CARAT siempre estará a su lado, aquí tendrán hombros de apoyo y oídos de sobra que los escucharán aún si la distancia es muy larga o la nacionalidad no es la misma, eso no es lo importante porque lo que nos une son nuestros corazones.
Los amo demasiado chicos, ustedes son los 13 diamantes que alumbran mi vida, mis diamantes, gracias por existir💎
Y aunque se que existen pocas posibilidades de que lean mi comentario quiero que sepan que lo escribí con mucha sinceridad, gracias por estar conmigo❤️
Como ustedes lo dijeron "Aunque estemos tambaleando sobre las olas, llegará el día en que caminemos sobre ellas" así que sigamos fuertes, apoyandonos unos a otros, siempre juntos.

가끔 세븐틴이 내 삶에 나타나지 않았다면 어땠을까 생각도 해보는데 정말 상상도 할 수 없을 만틈 세븐틴이 저에겐 많은 위로와 힘을 주는 그룹이에요. 지금 시국이 시국인 만큼 세븐틴도 캐럿들도 힘들텐데 얼른 이 사태가 모두 끝나서 반짝이는 곳에서 함께 노래할 수 있는 날이 오면 좋을 것 같네요. 그런 날이 다시 돌아올때까지 세븐틴을 응원할거고 곁에 있을거니까 무너져도 다시 일어나서 같이 앞으로 나아가주면 좋겠어요. 아무런 걱정도 하지 말고 그냥 서로만 믿으면서 한 계단 한 계단 걸어 올라가요. 이런 선택을 하게 된 것을 후회하지 않고 앞으로도 하지 않을거에요.

As a Muslim like me, we should not be obsessed with sick things because it will make us forget who the creator is but in religion we are allowed to spend time with our own entertainment. And this is my own entertainment to appreciate the seventeen songs and appreciate their hard work, honestly I really like the seventeen because they always make me feel happy all the time, their crazy antics keep me entertained in my time even if they will not once knew me as I knew them all.

Yes, of course I really like their song, it can be said that every time the song seventeen is what I will listen to when I do a job, but still our religion does not recommend it because this matter is very obsessed with us because we have to pray a lot to our creator but I will try not to get too sick with this kpop world, in my religion we need to pray more to our creator and I hope my other Muslim friends are also not too obsessed with this kpop world because it will damage our faith, so I beg to you to be modest in this kpop world.

I became a fan of them when I was in high school, but not too hard at the time and in my school not many people knew seventeen because at that time many of my friends really liked bts. At that time I was quite interested in bts their song i was also very quiet to listen to. Don't get me wrong I never hated bts because they are very talented people, but when i entered university i became a hardcore fan of seventeen because my heart always felt entertained by their crazy and funny attitude.

Not only that their songs, their hard work and their enthusiasm in the group made me feel like I wanted to support them very hard. And I see one by one they grow from being a teenage boy until they become a very passionate man to do the best for their own fans.

I hope you do not quickly punish me just because of my religion, I am also a human being who wants to find pleasure and happiness in my life by listening to their songs when I feel bored. And I will always support them until the last say the name seventeen !!!.

To every carat who read this. Even we don't know each other, lets stay together, forever, with seventeen. Let's love seventeen forever and support them. AND ONE THING’S FOR SURE, I’LL NEVER REGRET CHOOSING SEVENTEEN ALL OVER AGAIN.

text: 세븐틴과 캐럿의 관계를 잘 설명해주는 곡.. 애틋함이 느껴지는 곡이라고 생각해ㅎㅎ 타그룹은 각종 논란도 있고 팬들을 대하는 자세에 있어서 무너짐이 있다고 생각한 그룹들도 있었지만 세븐틴은 변함없이 소중히 생각해주고 친근하게 대해주는데 캐럿들에게 선을 지키고 예의있게 행동하고 개념있는 모습만을 보여주는게 너무 좋고 자랑스러워. 세븐틴이 데뷔 전 힘들었던 걸 캐럿들은 알고 있고 솔직히 나는 그런 과정이 있었기에 세븐틴이 지금처럼 후배들이 존경하고 훌륭한 아티스트가 될 수 있었다고 생각해. 한 방에 얻는 인기가 아니라 천천히 꾸준히 자신의 힘으로 성장해나가는 가수여서 팬들의 소중함도 잘 알고 고마움을 잘 표현해주는 것 같다. 요즘은 여기저기서 세븐틴이 예의바르고 너무 좋은 사람이라고 듣는 일이 많아서 행복해. 세븐틴을 좋아한 지 4년정도 되어가는데 갈 수록 마음이 식기는 커녕 더 알아보고 싶고 자랑스럽고 함께 성장하고 싶은 마음 뿐이야. 4년동안 좋아하면서 불안했던 적도 있어. 하지만 그래도 솔직한 모습을 종종 보여주면서 서로를 믿자라는 말을 생각하며 계속 좋아해왔고, 절대 후회하지 않아. 너무너무 고마웠고 앞으로도 캐럿들 하고 잘 해나가보자. 진짜로 보고싶고 언젠가 다시 보는 날 울컥할 것 같네ㅠㅠㅠ 건강히 잘 지내 세븐틴 ;)

author: @chizdawg9870
text:
Just finished watching. Had to pause this a couple of times because I am so overwhelmed with my emotions. Literally crying right now. Damn I love seventeen so much that no words can ever express it. Before slipping into the diamond life, I used to be so lost and empty. Whenever people would ask me what I really want to become in life, all I'd say is that Iwant to be happy. All I've ever wanted was to be happy. It first started with watching carat made videos with seventeen's funny moments, then watching going seventeen, then finally listening to their music. For so long, i've taught myself to not feel emotions, so that i won't get hurt but damn seventeen's songs made me feel. ACTUALLY FEEL EMOTIONS just by listening to their song and reading their lyrics. I was so shocked because I've listened to millions of songs before but nothing has ever moved me the way their songs did. Because of them, I faced my emotions that I buried deep down. I accepted parts of myself I thought I'd always be ashamed of. I learned to love myself more than anything in this world and it feels so damn good. I used to be so afraid of facing the world because I didn't want to get hurt but seventeen inspired me. The way they faced the world, the way they always worked hard, the way they always stand up taller every time they fell down, the way they love each other, the way they pour parts of themselves in every masterpiece they produce, the way they're so passionate in everything they do (even in playing games), and the way they're always positive that no matter what happens, it'll be alright because things would get better. They inspired me to live life, to actually passionately LIVE, work hard, and they made me brave that even if i face rejections or failures, it's alright. I used to be so afraid of being hurt, rejected, and failing but now those things energizes me to work harder and live life better. I can finally look in the mirror and genuinely smile because now i know that i'm happy. really happy. No matter what challenges come my way, I'm not scared anymore. And even when I get sad, I just listen to seventeen's music, watch their spectacular performances, watch going seventeen and all their other videos, and I'd instantly cheer up and feel comforted because if these 13 boys worked so hard and achieved so many things then I believe I can achieve my dreams too. More than the awards and achievements that seventeen have, what I'm most proud of is who they've become as artists and as people. Their music healed and saved people. They've become that light that inspires and guides people. Even after 10,20 or even 50 years, I would always be grateful to Seventeen because they helped me love myself and love life. Choi Seungcheol, Yoon Jeonghan, Hong Jisoo, Wen Junhui, Kwon Soonyoung, Jeon Wonwoo, Lee Jihoon, Xu Minghao, Kim Mingyu, Lee Seokmin, Boo Seungkwan, Chwe Hansol, Lee Chan, Thank you. No words can ever describe how insanely talented and amazing you are. Us, Carats, are very very proud of everything you've achieved and who you've become. We will always be here for you. We will always support you and have your backs💓💎💓 Also thank you to Carats because y'all are the most peaceful, loving, caring, and supportive people I've ever met! Let's all live passionately, work hard to reach our dreams and support Seventeen! 

Much love, 
M.V.R.A.P ❤️

author: @tejaswi2105
text:
One thing I'm always looking for is love ! 
Our community have wrong definition of love ..
 humiliating someone to the level ..that the person will cry or unreasonable hate or bullying or negative reinforcement or hammering someone with saying that you are not  worthy of love  or your blood /ancestors are the reason why you need to suffer even though you hv done nothing or conflicts in thoughts...these all things makes me wonder what love looks like ? Am I really worthy of love ? Will I ever experience it ?? And genuinely at this point I'm scared.
My life journey till now have taught me that love comes in all different forms..even a simple smile or few encouraging words can give that happy feeling . I need those words .I need someone to say that I'm a good person. I need someone to say that I've been through a lot and deserves all happiness .
I've never been so vocal about my needs..I tried not share this side of me to my friends or colleagues ..only few know this ..and they care for me ..but I don't want to bother them again and again.
PPL say that I'm very kind person ..with a really beautiful smile , I wish I could tell them this smile and kindness comes after all those dark nights where I cried in silence ..so that no one will understand that I'm crying.
Cause all those tears told me to give love as much as possible to everyone around you .. because make sure you won't be the reason for someone else's tears .
I wish I could be more vocal about my problems..but somewhere I gotta keep the dignity of the PPL who create all trouble in my life . It's complicated..
Hence I'm telling ya'll to be kind and nice person..to everyone who comes in your way . Spread love .
                                   - 23 year old human

author: @finibestiara3948
text:
Several years ago, I dont like Kpop because my friends who become a fandom of a group expressed it in the wrong way so that I think kpop was a bad thing. 

But one day came, and I didnt know why that made me started to open myself to kpop until I know BTS and became an Army several years after that (it was really hard for me to realize that I loved them that much because I already thought that kpop was negative). I decided to become an Army because I really need someone to comfort me at that time. 

After that, I stan BTS only for a long time. And now I just became Carat. After they joined Bighit label I started to know them and I realized that they deserve my love as well. 

Besides Seventeen, there so many other groups that I tried to know, and I never felt something in them except TXT. So it is not like I love them because they are from Bighit label as BTS, but it is really because they are a great group. The thing that made me delay to know Seventeen because they are 13 members and I was afraid if something will happen to them. But now I know that they have a great bounding and personality so that I know that they will solve all their problem together and regret a bit not to know them earlier. 

After I realized that I need Seventeen in my life, I started to follow their social media, watch their content, also join the voting to support them. I have no bias because I know they all already worked hard and appreciate them in the same way. I am also not the type of person that likes to comment like this, but after hearing this song I decide to write this and I hope someone of you will read it as well. As I said I'm a new Carat, I just know them during this pandemic and never saw them in person. However,  this song makes me wanna meet them as I miss them very much and know them for a long time ago. This song comforts me, makes me feel I can go everywhere because they will protect me. 

I am sorry if I bring the other group to this comment. But I need to mention them because I want you to know if it is not an easy way for me to like something and they deserve my love that much. After this, I will always support them. I promise that I will be a good fan and I hope can really meet them in person someday. And last, sorry if there is a typo or grammatical error because English is my second language. Thank you, love you all!!!

author: @erickaruiz7165
text:
Hola carat, no sé si alguien algún día lea esto, espero que no porque me da mucha pena mostrar mis sentimientos jjsja 
Estos días han sido muy difíciles para mi existencia.
Entré a una escuela para ser maestra de español de secundaria, y no existe una razón de porqué entré aquí pero estoy haciendo mi mayor esfuerzo por poder encajar en esto y sentirme parte de algo y no quedarme sin estudiar algo que puede ser de mucha ayuda en mi futuro y que tal vez sea algo que de verdad me gusta hacer.
Como seguro te diste cuenta, no esto estoy segura si esta es mi vocación o no, por lo que es difícil decidir si me quedo aquí o no, decidir algo tan importante que determina mi futuro y estas decisiones que estoy tomando me llevan día a día al lugar al que pertenezco, decidir salirme de esto sin saber lo que quiero realmente a mi corta edad de 17 años, y aunque tal vez es una edad en donde tus pensamientos son maduros y estás seguro de lo que te hace feliz, siento que a mi aún no me llega eso y me siento completamente triste, vacía, perdida y sobre todo estúpidamente tonta.
Tengo miedo de equivocarme y decepcionar a mi familia y a todas las personas que me apoyan y sobre todo a mi misma, terminar cansada de un camino al que no pertenezco y perderme sin llegar a ningún final feliz.
Para serles sincera, no había escuchado esta canción ya que el tiempo fue pasando y nunca coincidí en entrar a la notificación o nunca me dieron ganas de abrirla, pero no me malinterpreten, Seventeen es una de mis mayores razones por las que quiero continuar existiendo, simplemente no me di a la tarea de escuchar la canción y leer la traducción para saber lo que nos querían transmitir, sin embargo, hoy que me encuentro en un mar de lágrimas sin entender nada ni entenderme a mi misma de la nada llegó a mi mente "Us, again". Leí la traducción y es lo que más necesito en este momento, y una vez más puedo confirmar que esto se trata de algo más que un amor fan-idol, se trata de un apoyo lleno de esperanza y cariño mutuo, en donde nos ayudamos a encontrarnos a nosotros mismos y aunque las personas van a seguir hablando, diciendo que se trata solamente de unas personas que amas tanto pero ellos no te aman a ti, cuando se trata de todo lo contario, es un amor que siento hasta el fondo de mi corazón y me llena de felicidad saber que existen personas que me ayudan y están para mi ayudándome en este camino tan largo y difícil. También mi cabeza va a hablar haciéndome creer que pudo haber sido cualquier otra cosa la que me levante el ánimo, alguien más cercano como mi familia o amigos o yo misma, sin embargo no puedo dejar de largo el hecho de que fueron ellos quienes me dieron la fuerza de seguir con esto y estoy infinitamente agradecida.
Mi lucha sigue en pie, pero se vuelve ligera sabiendo que alguien me está apoyando.

text: 저는 지금 20살 인데, 저는 고등학생이 될 때까지, 그리고 고등학생이 되고나서도 많은 정말 상처투성이였고 괴롭게하는 나날들이 많았어요 저에게 쌍둥이 동생이 있는데,  선천적으로 장애를 가지고 태어나서 사랑도 동생에게 빼앗겼었고 항상 어른들은 동생이 아프니까, 너가 누나니까 참아야한다는 말을 많이 들었어요 그리고 7살 때부터 제가 안좋은 습관이라고도 할 수 있는데 울고싶어도 저는 울려고 하지 않았어요 제가 울어도 달라지는건없고, 울어도 봐주는 사람이 없다고 생각해서 안괜찮아도, 울고싶어도 웃으려고 했어요 그래야 괜찮아 질 것 같아서, 웃어야 한다 생각했어요 그래야 괜찮아질 것 같아서, 그리고 자기최면으로 지아야, 익숙하잖아, 울면 너만 이상해져 라고 자기최면을 했어요 그리고 초등학교 때 부터 고등학교 때까지 심하게 왕따를 당하게 되고 항상 저를 남자화장실에 가두고 누군가의 잘못을 뒤집어쓰고 사물함을 열면 쓰레기가 나오고 뭐만하면 항상 저만 욕먹으면서 고등학생이되었는데 이 습관이 아예 익숙해져서 저는 울려고 하지 않고 웃고, 상처받아도 티내지 않고 자기최면으로 '익숙하잖아, 한 두번도 아니잖아, 괜찮아, 웃자, 울어도 아무도 안봐줘, 울면 너만 이상한 사람될껄?'이렇게 자기최면했고 힘들어도 주변에 힘들다고 말하지 않고 괜찮아, 힘내자 울어도된다고 생각하는것이 이상하다고 생각할 정도로 몸에 그냥 아예 모습이 베였었어요 그리고 2019년도 정말 단 하루도 쉬지 못했어요 제가 모든 것을 짊어져야 하게 됬을 때 , 즉 리더의 자리로 서게 됬을 때가 있었어요 내가힘들어하면 동생들도 힘들거고 동생들도 아프고 함들텐데 내가 여기서 이러면 안돼라는 생각과 함께 내 밑에 있는 동생들을 위해 웃고 혼자서 짊어지고 가는 부분이 많았어요 그리고 밤낮으로 계속되는 스케줄과, 연습, 모임이 많았어 가지구 뛰어다니구 바쁘게 살다보니 2020년 1월 1일 결국 쓰러졌어요 스트레스를 너무 많이 받게 되다보니 과로가 오게 되면서 쓰러지고 응급실에 가서 치료를 받고 어느덧 정신을 차려보니 지금이 되어있더라구요 그리고 응급실에서 쉬면서 내가 쉬질 못했구나 라는 생각도 들었고 응급실에서 세븐틴 오빠들의 노래를 듣고있었는게 웃음꽃을 들으면서 위로도 많이 얻게 되었고 그 이후, 시간이 지난 후에 우리, 다시라는 곡을 들으면서 내가 괜찮아지고 싶어서, 참기 위해 억지로 웃는 것이 아닌, 진짜 내가 웃고 싶어서, 내가 웃음을 원해서, 즐거워서 웃을 수 있게 되었어요 정말 오빠들 덕분에 제가 웃을 수 있게 되었어요 웃고 싶어서 웃게 되었고 우리, 다시를 듣는데 너무 눈물이 났어요 정말 많이 울었어요 지칠 때가 많았어요, 울고싶을 때가 참 많았는데 그걸 참다보니 저는 저를 잃어가고 나이에는 맞지 않게 행동하다가 누군가 저에게 '정말 많이 힘들었겠다, 참는데 얼마나 힘들었을까?,부모님보다 너가 제일 많이 걱정됬어, 왜냐하면 너는 동생을 보면서도 마음이 아팠을텐데 그 외에도 왕따, 그리고 사랑받지 못한 것에 대해서, 그리고 그 외에 많은 아픔과 상처가 많았을텐데, 참지 않아도 돼, 나이에 맞게 행동해도 돼, 너무 참을 필요없어, 그냥 크게 울어도 돼' 라고 말해주더라구요 그리고 오빠들을 보면서도 많이 느꼈어요 쉬어가도된다는 것을 잠시 쉬고 솔직해져도 된다는 것을 참 많이 느꼈어요 오빠들 정말 고마워요 이런 것들을 알려줘서, 웃을 수 있게 해줘서, 위로해줘서 정말 고마워요 진짜 웃음을 기억하개 해줘서 정말 고마워요 울어도되구나.. 울어도 괜찮구나... 울어도 나를 안아주는 사람이 있을거야 라는 생각이 들 수 있도록 이렇게 예쁜가사를, 곡을 선물해줘서 너무너무 고마워요 정말.. 고마워요

YOU'RE SO DAMN TRUEEEE. im a new carat and i really regret i didn't join this fandom earlier. people who know svt and stan them are soooooooooo lucky.  there are soooooooo many benefits of being a Carat. some of them are: 
1st, all of svt songs are so great, deep, healing, inspiring, motivating and encouraging. 
2nd, all of their choreography is very beautiful, very symbolic, unique, complex, various and always sooooooooo satisfying.
3rd, all the members are so damn talented. all of them can rap, dance, sing, and they all are handsome and goodlooking as well. group with 13 rappers, 13 vocals, 13 dancers, and 13 visuals. and what's really cool is, they are known as the king of synchronization even though they are the group with the most members, it 's just very cool, i cant stop being so proud of my self for being their fan. 
4th, they are one and only self producing kpop idols, not just writing lyrics, but also composing, making choreo, and much more. which is mean that most of their amazing songs are really from them, made by them, for us carats. it's make me feel so loved and cared by them because of all the things they've done for us, for all the healing and soothing songs and all the deep lyrics. for all the funny going seventeen episodes that make my day, make me so happy and cant stop laughing, oh God, im really so in love with them. 
5th, even though they do everything themselves, they are still no less good than the other groups, they are even the best. they are the most different kpop group of all time, the complete form, the most talented, the best ever, there's no other group like seventeen, as perfect as seventeen, as talented as seventeen. seventeen is the one and only, the best forever and ever and ever. I'M SO PROUD OF BEING CARAT, EVEN THOUGH IT HASN'T BEEN 2 MONTHS SINCE I BECAME CARAT, I'M ALREADY SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO IN LOVE WITH ALL 13 OF THEM. Early days I knew them I always really hate seeing any of them interact with any girl, I always felt really jealous. but after I got to know them more, how hard they work, how they do everything themselves, how they struggle to reach their dreams in a not big and great agency, how they can got this far from their own efforts, how talented they are all, and how their songs are not just songs, all their songs have deep meaning and give positive energy to other people, how many touching things they 've done for carats and many other people, all of that makes my mind about them change. now I see them more as family, very close friends, brothers, than as men. now I still have desire to get one of them as a boyfriend, but now it's not as big as when I was just know them. now, as long as they are all happy and stay together, it doesn't matter if they want to date anyone, I'm really willing and accept it as long as they are happy, their happiness is my 1st priority, they're soooo precious to me, they really deserve a lot of happiness, i really really really love them so much. i just want them to always be happy and success forever

text:
They comfort me in a way my family and friends couldn't. 
It's almost unreal how I feel this unbreakable bond with them.
It's almost like I know them personally. 
I don't see them as boyfriends or whatever Kpop industry tries to sell their artists as but they're more like my support system. 
I want to thank them but that can never be enough. 
I wish I could see them someday. 
I was in a dark place from where I was dubious I could ever return. 
It was them who helped me. 
They somehow got through my thick skull, through all the pain and dark thoughts and made be believe that there's a better place. 
A simple thanks will never be enough I know but till the day we sing together again, I'll be waiting for you at your every step, cheering you, just like you did for me. 
If you ever get lost, we'll wait for you patiently to find your way back to us again. 
We've got your back fam.
This song is so beautiful I want it to imprint on my soul.

text:
Seventeen debuted on May 26 with a live showcase televised by MBC. They were the first male K-pop group to debut with a one-hour live showcase on a major broadcasting channel, with label-mates Lizzy and Raina serving as MCs. Three days later, their first EP 17 Carat was digitally released.17 Carat became the longest-charting K-pop album of the year in the US and was the only rookie album to appear on Billboard's "10 Best K-Pop Albums of 2015" chart.

On September 10 their second EP Boys Be was released, which would later become the highest selling rookie album of 2015. The album's success earned the group awards at the Golden Disk Awards, Seoul Music Awards, and Gaon Chart K-Pop Awards. Seventeen was also the only K-pop group on Billboard's "21 Under 21 2015: Music's Hottest Young Stars" 

Seventeen held a four-date concert series titled 2015 Like Seventeen – Boys Wish from the 24th to the 26th of December as an end-of-year celebration in Seoul. After the concerts' success, Seventeen held two related concerts the following February in 2016, entitled Like Seventeen – Boys Wish Encore Concert.

세븐틴도 어두운 밤 걸을 때, 걱정 하지 마. 세봉이들 뒤엔 캐럿이 있잖아. 캐럿이 아름다움이 유지하는 방법은 세븐틴이고, 세븐틴의 아름다움은 우리가 더욱 더 보이게 해줄테니까. 
항상 너희 진심 잘 보고, 듣고 있어. 너희 노래로, 행동 혹은 말로 매일 위로 받은 나고, 세븐틴에게 기대는 나야.
 나에겐 버팀목만 되어주었던 너희가 이제는 맘 편히 나,
 그리고 캐럿들 에게도 기댈 수 있으면 좋겠다. 
맨날 너희가 뭘 해주려 하지 않아도.. 자연스래 캐럿들은 위로도, 칭찬도 받으니까 부족하다 하지마, 제발. 
나를 욕 하는 것 보다 너희가 스스로에게 나쁜 점만 찾아 말을 하는 모습이 더 마음아파.. 
캐럿들은 우리 사이에 무슨 일이 있어도 다시 만날 수 있는 사이고, 그런 사이를 만들어낸게 우리니까.
 멀어진다 두려워 하지 말아줬으면 해. 
지금은 좋은 날이니까, 지금은 그런 일이 없으니까.. 지금은 기뻐하자. 즐거워하고, 항상 웃고 다니자.
 만약 우리가 헤어지더라도, 속도가 달라 멀어지더라도 꼭 만날 수 있을테니, 그래야만 하니. 걱정 하지 말고, 무서워 하지 말고.. 
그 때 일은 그 때 가서 생각하도록! 
이게 쉬운건 아니지만, 그래도 이런 말로 마음이 좀 가벼워 지면 좋겠다. 세븐틴이랑 우리랑 헤어지게 된다면, 
만약 그렇다면 난 이 말을 새기고 살아갈 거야. 
"우리, 다시 서로의 이름을 외치는 그 날까지, 그 날 이후도 너희와 우리를 향해 이어져있는 이 길은 끝나지 않을 거야. 그러니까 조금만 더 기다리자" 
난 우리가 떨어지더라도, 버틸 수 있으니 언젠가는 만날 수 있을거라 믿고 있을게.
항상 고맙고, 미안하고, 사랑한다 세븐틴

去想那时候的事!

author: @behindthescreen2906
text:
Right now, I don't think I could go to their concert without thinking about those videos. What I mean is that, it would never gonna be the same anymore. The moment I would watch their concert, I would probably asking myself are they already tired, exhaused, drained? Are they still okay? Their health? I wanna cry. Maybe the moment I watch them performing would never be the same as usual. After watching all those episodes, I would watch them with a heart full of proudness. Eyes covered with tears of joy and a mouth shouting how proud I am for them. We always saw SVT performing full of joy and happiness and seeing these whole thing—behind their successful performances, changes my perspective. These precious being deserve the whole damn universe. Thank you for letting us saw these other sides of yours, for showing us all you have gone through. For showing us how you are still fighting and giving all that you've got for you're gems—the carats. Now I can see clearly how those tears and sweats washed their ships to where they are today. All those hard works will surely gonna paid off. Keep soaring high, my Angels

Now, I fell harder the second way a round. I think, I am already drowning too deep, falling too hard. SVT would be the greatest fall that I would gladly take to risk at and I don't think I need saving anymore.

it's 20XX, they stand together in one stage, 13 of them are there, facing their fans with a warm smile. that day is their last concert, they are no longer an idol group anymore after this. they are growing old, some of them are still continuing their carreer as a veteran singer and veteran actor, meanwhile some other are handling their business company from home, watching their child and grandchild living happily with them as a full family, etc. the last stage is this song, Us, Again. many days, months, and years have passed away since the first time they released this hurt-comforting song out on June, 8 2020. no matter how long time has passed they are still singing this song with the same feeling, like back then, when they were still strong and young. but this time, they give their all out to sing this song once again, as this farewell will never happened, for the very last time. but one thing for sure is we all know that like what they have always said is "whatever happen to us, we will meet again." they shout their last say the name, seventeen, with a deep-long bow. no words needed, their strong intertwined fingers explain them all. and the lighting goes black, the curtain is closed. the travel is ended here finally, but the journey would never.
-061020, jun's 24 bday, 2.08 AM

author: @asthelilygrows4430
text: I've been a fan of kpop for more than ten years now -- taking a couple of breaks along the way. Discovering SEVENTEEN, their music, their brotherhood - everything about them at this point in my life must have been fate. I've met them as I entered adulthood and their music resonated to me on a deeper level. You just feel how much they take time to create music that will comfort their fans. Even without understanding the words behind Us, Again before - I can feel the sincerity in their voices. I can feel how much they care for their fans.  Hearing someone sing to you how it's okay to slow down, how it's normal to experience low points in your life -- it's okay because at the end we as carats always have seventeen. I just hope they really know and feel that same goes for them -- even after the last "say the name", we'll be there for them. We don't know where life will take us but being able to share these memories with SEVENTEEN. I know we'll always have each other. I'll gladly stay to go on this journey with 13 wonderful human beings. SEVENTEEN, thank you for conveying your thoughts, and opening up your feelings to us. Thank you for being our home, a warm blanket that hugs us at the end of each day.

I'm one that doesn't stream or do much online, i have my reasons but i do buy their albums and went to their latest concert.  
I just love how CARATs genuinely support and feel their music, how we appreciate both the group and the staff behind them. Because for a lot of other groups (mainly the popular or somewhat mainstream boy groups) when i watch the comments on their MVs all i see is the words 'stream/streaming' and 'views'. Is okay to do those, sometimes for x amount of views in some vids we get special content or something. But seeing how "obsessed" in a way certain fandoms are about such things makes me think that they don't really care for the quality of the MVs, the songs and/or how much effort by the artist and staff was put into making them. Which is a pity. I scroll so much until i read comments saying how the person felt listening to the song, something about the music video or anything that is not about how they didn't reach 1 million views in 5 minutes after the video was dropped.

text:
Through these rough days I've been going through right now, I am so glad there's SEVENTEEN♡

"To help you walk with no trouble, I'll pave a road for you someday"

These days where I feel really restless, they came and reminded me I'm not alone.

"On the strange road,  anyone can be lost. I'll be with you on the rocky way"

With these thoughts, even though I know I am just a fan against millions, I believe in our hearts we reciprocate these feelings..

"Every reason and path, is beautiful because of you."

And no matter how hard the days are, I know a part of me gets strength to keep going through them and their music.

"If we pass the turning point at the end of the road, I will protect you so you won't be worn out anymore."

So I hope one day, all will be better and I can finally say "I'm sincerely happy now and you helped me a lot". Until then, with brightest smiles and hearts filled with joy,

"Whatever happens to us, Let's meet again."

author: @msmsmsms1
text:
I want to tell this story to you. I have a friend, an internet friend to be exact. He was alone at the moment since he was quarantined somewhere far from his family because of covid 19. I met him like just a week ago and I became fond of him immediately. Then, we chatted each other almost everyday and I learned he is depressed and suicidal. Yesterday, the day where this song released was also his birthday and the sad part is that his whole family forgot about it. He called them to tell them that it’s his 15th birthday but his family never cared. He was so sad and was about to end his life by overdosing his pills. Then, the time he told me his plan, this song was released. There, I was anxious about it and after hearing this song, I wanted to send this to him to rethink. He is a fan of one direction and he somewhat not fond of kpop that’s why I was anxious if I should send this to him or nah. In the end, I managed to send this song to him and I told him to listen to it. 

After a few hours, he chatted me, “thank you for this heartwarming song” and I felt relieved. I was anxious before he chatted me back because I told him if he was planning to end his life, please listen this song that could change your mind. He actually sent me a long message but he thanked me for the song recommendation. He told me he doesn’t understand a single thing but somehow it felt like the song is telling him to keep on living. He also apologized to me and all. Nonetheless, I’m so glad he decided to keep on living. Right now, he is trying his best to be positive and I’m so glad. He might not be a carat but this song moved him so much.

Dear Seventeen,
MANSAE! This song HIT me again. I keep saying that I DON'T WANNA CRY, but OH MY! I just did and my heart went BOOM BOOM. You made those things disappear gradually like a FALLIN' FLOWER. You're the HOME of every lonely heart, you're the comfort of every bewildered soul.

This is an oath: I promise to take the road with you until the last say the name. I will take the road with you, be it rocky or concrete. Together, with you and my fellow carats, we will have our HAPPY ENDING. Things may separate us at some point, but a song is enough to get us back again. Just one melody from you guys and I already know we're GETTING CLOSER towards each other. And I, I solemnly swear that no matter how many years would get by, it would forever be US, AGAIN.

text:
I will protect and support SEVENTEEN at all costs because they been saving me all this time.
I've been thru some difficult shit to the point I thought that giving up will be easier than fighting. But seeing them start from rock bottom, struggling and continue doing their best to reach their dreams change my heart. I suddenly thought I also want to do my best I also want my dreams to come true I also want to be free from everything that's been chaining me. Yes, it wasn't easy there were times I thought that only chosen privilege individuals are able to reach their goals. But every single comeback they remind me nothing is easy, just keep doing your best, keep your head upon your goal, keep improving, compete with yourself not with others until the time that all your hard work pays off. I was rushing and juggling everything so that I can finally see the results of my hard work yet nothing was happening. And every time I feel like this their music, again and again, saves me from giving up. SEVENTEEN thank you for reminding me this time that I have time that there's no need to rush that I can pause and breathe then continue from where I left off. You guys really are amazing. I love you to no end.

author: @fujoshina8957
text:
Seventeen's presence in my life is the most inspiring and amazing sensation from mansae era and onwards. I have looked to them to feel positivity and optimism towards the life I lead. Whenever I'm down and consoling to friends they would tell me, "listen to seventeen!" As a way to cheer me up because they know how much seventeen has brought me joy in hard times when I couldn't find the motivation to even smile. 

I admit there was a time where I fell out of seventeen or more of like held out on them. I don't mean to bring up an extremely sensitive subject but after Jonghyun's death it made me realize the extent of an Idol's life and how different it is to how they really are (I've always known this but when something incredibly serious happens its makes it frighteningly real). I admit, though not fair, I began to distrust seventeen's sincerty and doubted everything they say in front of the camera because I felt it was a script or a director telling them what to say. I wasnt even a shawol but having grown up with the 2nd gen kpop groups, it still left me in a sobbing mess for days. This made me scared that if the same thing were to happen to seventeen, god forbid, I can not imagine the downfall of my mental and emotional state. I got so scared that I started to distance myself from seventeen and kpop in general. 

After a year, I finally returned and though I am not as active or as invested as I used to be, I rediscovered my deep gratitude and appreciation for seventeen. Through this series, it made me break down those walls of doubt and mistrust that I held towards seventeen. If there is one thing I can count on from seventeen, it is their raw and honest feelings they hold for us as we do for them. I see them as brothers and friends who are filled with wisdom and kindness. They have and always were my ultimate group but they will be the only group I deeply care for and spend time watching. I appreciate other groups too but I just listen to their songs as opposed to getting too into them as a group or people. For me, these 13 men are all I need to be content and happy in the kpop fandom.

text: It's taken me a day to fully put all my words coherently... and I know that there are so many other people who feel the same way, that Seventeen has been the home I can come home to. The moment this song came out I was just sobbing, holding my chest and just chanting many thank yous to the air. I felt so comforted and... I didn't feel alone, finally. For the whole day I put this song on loop and I've been streaming it. Even though I know Seventeen shouldn't be my everything, they have been such a big part of my life. They've always brought me back up. They've taught me that it's okay to not walk so quickly all the time. We'll all get there, it isn't a matter of time. I definitely haven't been with Seventeen since the beginning, but I know I'll stay until the end. The last "say the name" might just be the start of something new, and when that day comes, I'll still be so happy and thankful for Seventeen. Imagine, 7 years of just love, producing beautiful music, making precious memories... this song just comforts themselves and CARATs as well that no matter what happens, we'll see each other again.

author: @mnemosyneimd5866
text:
For years, I struggled with depression. It really messed me up, and clouded my high school and early college years with doubts and insecurities. After having to withdraw from school for the sake of my mental health this December, I hit a low point. I wasn't sure if I could go on, or if I'd lost my way forever. Still, I had one thing to look forward to--I'd started stanning Seventeen in August of 2016, but I hadn't had an opportunity to go to one of their concerts until now. Slowly, I'd come to love and trust them, until they became the brightest light in my world. Then, I got to see them in Newark this past January.

Everything changed. I could feel it start when they started singing 9-Teen, as I was two months shy of my 20th birthday--at the end of my teenage years, and the lyrics really resonated with me. Then, after the last Aju Nice, their last goodbye, standing there under the infinite confetti rain, listening to Our Dawn is Brighter Than Day, one of my favorite songs, I really understood--I'm loved by these thirteen amazing young men. These people who cheered with me for the last three hours, they're with me through this. I can do this. For the first time in five years, holding a piece of confetti, I felt truly alive.

Six months later, and I'm back in school, earning A's for the first time since middle school. I found my path, and I'm walking it hand in hand with Seventeen.

Thank you to Seventeen, for bringing light back into my life. Thank you Carat, for passing the torch to me. I love you all.

text: I can't believe it's already been 5 years with my 13 kings T.T Seventeen has truly gotten me through some of the darkest moments of my life, especially after my father passed away 6 months ago. Their "Ode to Your" tour in the US was the only thing I was able to look forward to during the winter. I can't even begin to express how thankful I am for all of the hard work Seventeen puts into their creative content and performances. They inspire me to find myself, and find reasons to keep going after my dreams. Seeing their raw, vulnerable sides in "Hit the Road" broke my heart in so many ways. They're so strong, but I only wish they allow themselves breaks to rest, and to heal, and seek the same comfort that I feel when I listen to their voices. They're like my 13 multivitamins - a daily dose of Seventeen has helped to alleviate my depression. They bring me so much laughter and light and warmth, that the only words I can say to capture my gratitude are "Thank you". I love you guys so much and will support you until the very end! Though I don't want to imagine a future without Seventeen, I know our memories will be immortalized in the music.

author: @katie0707
text:
it’s half way through the day and i’m in floods of tears. no one will ever understand the amount of love and appreciation i have for seventeen. for each and every member. they’ve helped me through it all. i don’t regret falling for them at all. they’re my brothers, my family, my home. thank you seventeen, for continuing to work hard no matter what. thank you for never giving up on your members or us, your carats. we’ll always be here, till the end and beyond then. i am forever grateful for each of you. 
i find it hard to open up about my emotions. all my sadness, tiredness and feelings build up and it’s only when everyone else in the house is asleep and it’s 2am where i can truly let my emotions out. i vent to seventeen’s music or to videos about them. i haven’t even finished hit the road yet because of how emotional i get. it breaks me to see them exhaust themselves for us and to feel depressed and anxious. it really made me realise that they’re human too, they’re no different from me.
when i listen to smile flower, or to hug, or to any slower seventeen song, i like to let the moment last. i don’t get the chance to listen to them often because i don’t allow myself to be upset. i’m embarrassed in front of others when i get upset. 
with us again, i feel even more passionate about my love for them. because of seventeen, i get through everyday and strive to be the best person i possibly can be, and that’s what they’d want for us. 
i don’t mean to get personal, but last year and the year before then, i was getting badly bullied in school. i dealt with it, and it got sorted out, but i had insane trust issues afterwards. to make it worse, in august of 2019, my cat passed away. he helped me through the bullying and he was my best friend. it was seventeen and seventeen alone who nursed me back to health and to a stable mindset. i’m still grieving over my cat, but thanks to seventeen i learned how to trust again and to love again. i now have the bestest friends anyone could ever hope for, and i know the most beautiful people ever, and it’s seventeen i have to thank for that.
thank you; seungcheol, jeonghan, jisoo, junhui, soonyoung, wonwoo, jihoon, minghao, mingyu, seokmin, seungkwan, hansol and chan. i will FOREVER be a carat, and i mean that. thank you for being there for me when i felt that no one else was. i will be there always, till the last say the name and after. ❤️❤️❤️

author: @chwehweui7336
text:
I was only 5th Grade when I became a Carat, I was so confused that time. I even thought the other members as the others HAHAHAHAHAH but that only last for 2 days. I've managed to memorize all of them. That was way back in 2017, in between DWC era and Baksu era. Then, they really inspired me that time even though I only started stanning them for like months. I am really motivated to finish my studies and everything.

 I, then, went to 6th Grade with recognition and honors, thanks to them. When I was in 6th grade, I remember me, being so problematic. But every time I listen to them sing and rap, watching them dance, watching them perform, watching them grow, watching them achieve their dreams, all of those problems were washed away by them. All I could see in myself that time was the smile and tears of joy that they brought to me. I graduated from elementary, thanks to Seventeen, once again.

 Leveled up again. 7th Grade then welcomed me last year, too many stress and frustration hugged me. I was so depressed, frustrated, stressed, and it even led me to anxiety. "Damn those studies. Damn these thesis. Damn these tests. Damn these diagnostics. Damn these lectures. Damn these family problems. Damn these fake friends. Damn this society. Damn." That's everything that I could only think of that time, but I thought of Seventeen. To soothe and ease all the pain away, I just let my thoughts shrink down and listen to Seventeen's songs. Hug then played. I really cried so hard and spent my whole night listening to Hug, as well as, Campfire, Run to You, Smile Flower, Thanks, and Home. I became motivated once again. I became optimistic. 

And I found myself, after months, free from stress (but not from frustration).I just finished my first year this year, and now moving on the 8th Grade. Thanks to Seventeen. 
My mother is really against with the thought of me, being a Kpop fan, and keeps on saying that I am just wasting my time for them. And whenever I am telling her that I would like to buy merch, she would say "you're wasting money." even if I am the one who will save money and pay for it. But I ignored that though, I will prove to Mom that Seventeen is not a distraction, afterall they are inspirations and our motivations. 
*Thanks to Seventeen. Thank you for everything you've done for us. Thank you from saving me, and other carats, from anxiety. Thank you for being the motivations and inspirations that we needed. Thank you for being the shoulders that we can lean on. Thank you for being our home and healing. Thank you for everything, Seventeen! Let's be together forever! Until the last! Say the Name, Seventeen!*
*Seventeen Best Boys!!* *SARANGHAEEE!*

author: @lai122486
text:
I think what makes Seventeen different for me from other groups is how connected they are with their fans.  Every song is a conversation with Carats.   Smile Flower, Thanks, Hit, shining diamonds, snap shoot, Clap and many more are their genuine thoughts and connection with Carats.  And in response,  you just cant help but just love them back.   I've fangirled over other groups before,  but ive never felt connection like this.    
And they could have monatized this and us fans would have bought it,  and yet they chose to release it for free.  They could have waited a couple weeks and release with their next single but they chose to release today instead.  Just dropped it no announcement because thats who Seventeen is.  And the care and thought they put into it with all the personal touches like the handwriting.  And how its connected to the HTR series about the hard work and pain that went through in a world tour just makes this more genuine and sincere instead of a plot to gain more fame or popularity.  
Yes,  I dont know how long I'll stay a hardcore fan of Seventeen, but I can promise that I will be there supporting them till the last say the name.

[Español]
Yo siento que hay muchos grupos que hacen canciones de este tipo (y como Smile Flower) cuando se van a disolver, para agradecer a las fans y despedirse de ellas. Por lo que, tengo sentimientos encontrados, por una parte me siento triste, pero por otra feliz, porque aman a todas sus fans por igual, puedan ir a sus conciertos o no, etc. Los quiero un montón.
[Galego]
Eu sinto que hai moitos grupos que fan cancións deste tipo (e como Smile Flower) cuando se van a disolver, para agradecer ás fans e despedirse delas. Pero Seventeen para nada, sinto que o fai para expresar dalgunha maneira canto nos ama e o agradecidos que están con nós, de que estemos con eles. Sinto que é unha maneira de dicirnos que eles sempre estarán para nós, ao igual que nós o estamos para eles. Sinto que é unha maneira de dicirnos que camiñamos moito xuntos, pero que aínda nos queda moito máis. Polo que, teño sentimentos encontrados, por unha parte síntome triste, pero por outra feliz, porque aman a todas as súas fans por igual, poidan ir aos seus concertos ou non, etc.

[English]
I feel that there are so many groups that make songs of this type (and like Smile Flower) when they're going to dissolve, to thank the fans and say goodbye to them. But Seventeen no, I feel that they do it to express in some way how much they loves us, how grateful they're that we're with them. I feel it's a way of telling us that they'll always be there for us, just as we're there for them. I feel that it's a way of telling us that we have walked a long way together but we still have more. So, I've mixed feelings, I feel sad (because of the song) and happy (because they love all their fans equally, whether they can go to their concerts or not, etc). I love them so much.

author: @채린-p9u
text:
초등학교 5학년이라는 어린 나이 때부터 아직 어리지만 사회에 나갈 준비를 하고 있는 고등학교 1학년이라는 지금의 나이를 가지게 될 때까지, 그리고 아직 다가오지 않은 미래까지 난 항상 세븐틴을 통해 위로, 행복, 즐거움 등 여러 감정을 얻을 수 있을 거고, 배움을 얻어갈 거예요. 장담할 수 있어요. 지금까지 항상 계속 그랬으니까.  

아직 어린데도 정말 죽고 싶다라는 생각이 들 때마다, 너무 힘들다는 생각이 들 때마다 세븐틴 노래를 들으면서 휴식을 하면 언제 그랬냐는 듯이 괜찮아졌고 아무 이유없이도 그냥 세븐틴 노래를 들으면 행복해졌고 나보다 더 나이가 많고 성숙할 사람들을 보며 진심 어린 응원을 하면서 점점 더 세븐틴이라는 그룹에, 또 각자에게 빠져들었던 거 같아요. 

나에게는 정말 너무 의미있는 사람들이고 그만큼 소중한 어쩌면 가족만큼의 영향력을 가진 사람들이라 이번 다큐 보면서 많이 울기도, 또 웃기도 했는데, '내가 아무리 좋아해도 이 사람들의 모든 걸 알 수 없는 건 어쩔 수 없는 거지.' 라는 생각이 더 뼈저리게 느껴졌고 '왜 이 사람들이 내가 보고 있던 그 상황에도 아팠을 수 있었단 걸 생각하지 못했을까', '나는 왜 마냥 받기만 했을까' 라는 생각을 했던 거 같아요. 난 세븐틴을 통해 얻은 게 수도 없이 많은데 정작 준 건 아무것도 없었단 생각이 들었어요. '좋아만 한다고 뭐가 달라질까' 하는 생각도 들었고요. 그치만 내가 캐럿이라는 또 다른 하나의 이름을 가지고 있는 상황이라면 언제든 난 세븐틴을 위할테고 세븐틴에게 많은 걸 얻을테니 더 열심히 도움을 줘야겠죠. 하고 싶은 것들을 더 할 수 있을 때까지. 

5년이라는 시간 동안 참 많은 노래들이 나왔는데 이 노래는 왜 이렇게 와닿는지 모르겠네요. 고맙다가 처음 나왔을 때 정말 많이 울었는데 그때랑은 또 다른 감정으로 펑펑 울면서 들었어요. 뭐... 또 다른 감정을 이렇게 배운 거겠죠? 

친구가 졸업도 못하고 세상을 떠나버렸단 소식을 접하자마자 정신도 못 차리고 숨도 못 쉬고 난리가 났을 때 정말 너무 급하게 세븐틴 노래를 찾았어요. 그래야 숨이 좀 트일 것 같아서. 그렇게 하루 종일 미친 것처럼 멍하니 노래만 듣다가 소리 지르고 우는 걸 반복하고 제대로 정신도 못 차린 상태로 친구의 장례식에 갔다 왔을 때 너무 힘들었는데 그때마저 세븐틴 노래 밖에 생각이 안나더라고요. 그만큼 내게 많은 공간을 차지하게 되었다는 거겠죠.

항상 너무 고맙고 아프지 않았으면 좋겠고 노래를 해줘서, 그렇게 우리의 곁으로 와줘서 정말 너무 고마워요. 내게 의미있는 가수가, 의미있는 사람들이 세븐틴이라는게 정말 너무 다행이고 세븐틴을 좋아할 수 있는게 너무 다행이예요. 고맙다는 말이 부족할 정도로 정말 너무 고마워요.

text:
i've been supporting them since 5th grade, in 2015. yes, i was a carat since 17 project and i really treasure them a lot, they've been my inspiration in doing a lot of things. hoshi influenced me a lot in my dancing hobby, woozi made me love my talent in singing, and s.coups became my role model in being a leader. in fact, all seventeen members influenced me a lot in my daily life. i honestly wouldn't know what to do if seventeen did not exist, and i'm really thankful for them. i just can't imagine my life without them. their songs have special meanings, some of which are songs which i can relate too. sometimes i think if seventeen could read my mind or something. 

i was there during every milestone they had, and i've witnessed (as a fan) their hard work to get those awards and achievements— which makes me proud. it's weird how i feel this way but seventeen made me live my life better.

since i was too young when i started stanning them, as i am still young up to this day, i've never got the chance to buy merch, albums, even my own lightstick, not because i don't love and invest my money for them, it's because i know that being a carat is not measured by how much merch you have or having your own carat bong. some may think that i'm weird for being a no-merch fan esp when i've been stanning them for so long. i swear, i really want to have my merch too, and it makes me sad because i can't buy them myself. but i never and will never stop loving them.

their love for us, carats is priceless. same goes to carats' love for seventeen. i sometimes think, "how can i marry a non-seventeen man?", i may not be by their sides but i feel like i lived with them within those five years of me being a carat. i hope every carat will have their significant other whom will love them like our boys love us carats.

I LOVE YOU FOREVER

text: Thank you, SEVENTEEN for loving all Carats from all over the world. I just want to say this representing all Carats, you will stay with us forever. That's a fact. text:
it looks like the lyrics are handwritten... they really wrote it and attached it there 😭 thank you, seventeen! i never thought that i can love someone like this. my love grows everyday for these hard working guys.  (Long unorganized thoughts ahead)
seungcheol, thank you for always taking care of the members, and not forgetting to take care of yourself. its not easy to stand at a very big stage, and im glad you did it! i hope you and the members are healthy. thank you for giving seventeen and carats strength.

jeonghan, thank you for your hardwork. thank you for looking for the members. thank you being a reliable "hyung" to the members. i hope your condition will also be well as always.

joshua, thank you for being a big brother to seventeen. you're really an inspiration not just to svt but also, us, carats. i hope you continue to do things that makes you happy and that you can have healing time.

jun, thank you for putting smiles on our faces. you sometimes seem the "quite one" but we, carats, can see how hardworking and passionate you are with your work. please take care always!

hoshi - thank you, our performance team leader. it must've been hard thinking and doing choreographies with your members, but you still continue your passion. thank you for being a strong and such a awesome guy on stage. You're a very good role model, i like you alot. i hope i can be like you someday. 

wonwoo - i hope you stay healthy ! some people say that you look cold but we all know that you got a very soft and good attitude! keep on doing what you like! you might have a low stamina but you still pour all of your energy on stage and we're forever grateful for that!

woozi - i really love how before, its a little bit of burden doing music for the group, and now you dont worry at all for it. yes, don't worry! please continue on doing what you love, we are always here to support! thank you!

minghao - we witnessed how big your style developed. im happy to see that you already what style and what things you really want to do. i hope you'll not be worried on anything. please take care!

mingyu - you're really a positive guy! i hope you can still be like that in the future! no matter what happens, i hope you still have a bright view. continue on doing films, we, carats are here to support! thank you!

seokmin - to the member that is the nicest guy next to God. you're such a brave but soft at the same time. our sun that gives us sunflowers (carats) strength. you're always doing well and i hope you know how much you've done! pre-debut till now! our king indeed!

seungkwan - thank you for always checking your members! you've worked really hard!!! please dont be so much hard to yourself and dont be hurt! i hope you continue on giving us strength with your voice. thank you our boo!

vernon - i hope youre always assured! im really happy to see you happy!!! your smile paints another smile! and im very thankful for that. continue on doing your music, don't be so hard to yourself. we can see how passionate you are with your work. thank you!

chan - future of kpop! yes, you are! you're very hardworking that's why you're here! doing whst you love, dancing. your dances are always special and unique. i hope you continue on doing it! i really get alot from you when you dance. i also want to be like you someday. thank you always!

im not very good with my words, i hope that i can express my feelings more in the future. every members quote from the documentary lives in my heart now. thank you for being a good role model to us. continue on doing what makes you happy and we're always thankful that you share those things to us. we will repay every love and hardwork you gave to us! I hope us, carats and seventeen, will be together more longer. lets be each other's happiness. let's be each other's strength. let's achieve our dreams together. the reason why im still doing it (my life), seventeen, thank you and i love you!

text:
I swear, Seventeen came into my life when I needed them the most. They saved me from myself. I honestly don’t know if I would be here right now typing this if it wasn’t for them. I’m glad I stayed. They saved me from my thoughts. They saved me from drowning in my emotions. I know I haven’t been there since the beginning but I’m here till the end. Someone out there knew I was struggling, they knew I needed someone bc they knew that I couldn’t help myself, what I didn’t know was that it was going to be 13 amazing boys. The same boys that make me laugh, the reason I stayed, this fandom, this family. One day when I’m older, I’m going to look back at all the memories, and I’m going to smile and say, those were the boys that saved me, the reason I kept walking, the reason I kept going. So, seventeen, thank you for all the moments, the laughs, the cries, the struggles, I’m glad we got to experience it all together. You’re also the reason I met a lot of new people and made new friends. You helped me realize I’m gay and I met my bf. I got to be able to be honest with myself. So, I can never thank you enough. But it’s like that’s all I can say bc there’s no other word out there that explains how grateful I am and I can only keep saying thank you and I love you.

author: @lmpp00
text: It's been pretty cold where I live, and it's past 3AM by now, but I think all of it comes beautifully together with this song. SVT is like the blanket that covers me right now, but far warmer. They're there for us, just like this song was here for me when I stumbled upon the notification. Just, hearing their voices, all of them singing just for us makes me realize how far they've gotten, and wonder what lies ahead of us. For example, hearing Vernon's voice in his beautiful singing is a long path from the past when he was put down over and over about it, and he's come a long way and I couldn't be more glad to hear him truly sing. To hear Cheol, Han and Shua, and everyone that was in the verge of quitting, Hao and Jun that left their countries to follow their dreams, every one of these amazing 13 men that give us everything they have and more in every song, in every performance. Hearing them be _here_ with all of us, I hope they feel happy with the outcome of many, many sacrifices, because as long as they let us, I'll walk together with them, hand in hand through music in the path of life. I'd love to say something about every one of them, but I do need to sleep someday or I'd be an hypocrite if I tell the boys to take care of themselves, and just by thinking of them I feel like I'll never shut up if I begin, so maybe for another day. Thank you so, so much for this beautiful song, wonderful experience and everything you do for us, always remember that Carat will always be there for you ❤

What all the beginning and endings of each episode said together 
Seventeen
